exposure: receptor tyrosine kinase with immunoglobulin-like and EGF-like domains 2 (Tie2)
outcome: protein expression of Ang1, Ang2, and Tie2
cohort: 7 placentas from normal-term and near-term pregnancies delivered by Cesarean section (36-41 week gestation) prior to the onset of labor
finding: Ang1, Ang2, and Tie2 are differentially expressed in placental center and periphery.
